description_en: Queries the information about the minor version of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescrbeKernelVersion接口查看目标数仓版集群的内核版本信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-kernel-version --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeKernelVersion

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.
You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612293.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

AvailableKernelVersions.description_en: The minor versions to which you can update the current minor version of the cluster
AvailableKernelVersions.description_zh: 当前版本支持升级到的目标版本列表

ExpireDate.description_en: The maintenance expiration time of the version. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format. The time is displayed in UTC. After the time arrives, the system no longer maintains the version. If any issues occur, update the minor version of the cluster to a later version
ExpireDate.description_zh: 版本维护到期时间，时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss。超过此时间后，系统将不再维护该版本，若有问题，请升级到更高版本

ReleaseDate.description_en: The time when the minor version was released. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format. The time is displayed in UTC
ReleaseDate.description_zh: 内核版本的发布时间。时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

ExpireDate.description_en: The maintenance expiration time of the version. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format. The time is displayed in UTC. After the time arrives, the system no longer maintains the version. If any issues occur, update the minor version of the cluster to a later version
ExpireDate.description_zh: 版本维护到期时间，时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss。超过此时间后，系统将不再维护该版本，若有问题，请升级到更高版本

KernelVersion.description_en: The minor version of the cluster. Example: 3.1.8
